name: r3_transfer
how: Data: data/crops/manifest.csv masked seed crops, datasets soybean_d97rjyk2tz and lin_v6vzvfszj6, grouped splits from scripts/data/make_splits.py. Two classes: sound vs broken. Soybean: class sound (Healthy) and broken (any box with Testa cracking); insect_hole dropped. Lin source_label mapped two ways: a) intact->sound, broken+skin-damaged->broken; b) intact->sound, skin-damaged->broken, Lin 'broken' (separated pieces) dropped from train and test. Directions soybean->lin and lin->soybean. Arms: source+k = model fitted on all source-train images pooled with k target-train examples per class; target_only_k = fitted on the k examples only; ceiling = fitted on all target-train images. k examples: k distinct groups per class from target-train eval_rep rows (Lin: one per near-duplicate group; soybean: one per photo), visiting groups in random order one image each and cycling only when k exceeds the number of groups (soybean groups are capture bursts, 27/28 broken/sound bursts in train, so k=50 reuses bursts; k_groups_mean in the curve gives the distinct groups used), 10 draws per k (seeds 1000*k+draw), k=0 is deterministic (1 run). Test: target test split, eval_rep rows (Lin: one per near-duplicate group; soybean: one per photo); multi_seed crops excluded everywhere. Model: frozen features (dinov2-small CLS+mean-patch) + harness 'logreg' (standardised, class-balanced logistic regression, C=0.5). Metric: per-class and macro F1 over sound/broken with grouped bootstrap 95% percentile CIs (2000 resamples of test groups; soybean test has only 9 broken and 10 sound capture bursts, so its CIs are wide; seed 0) per run; curve reports mean/SD/min/max of F1 over draws and the mean of per-draw CI bounds. Pooled-source variant = source+k (only two labelled soybean sets exist, so no larger pool). Caveat: the two 'broken' definitions differ, so the drop mixes label shift with domain shift.
